primary_selection_models.name: UCAT Cut-off
primary_selection_models.description: Applicants must pass minimum academic screening and meet a fixed or dynamic UCAT threshold.

primary_selection_models.name: UCAT Ranking
primary_selection_models.description: Applicants who pass academic screening are ranked by UCAT cognitive total score.

primary_selection_models.name: Academic Ranking
primary_selection_models.description: Applicants who pass minimum screening are ranked mainly by academic score.

primary_selection_models.name: Academic + UCAT Weighting
primary_selection_models.description: Academic score and UCAT score are combined using percentages or points.

primary_selection_models.name: Points System
primary_selection_models.description: Applicants receive points for components such as GCSEs, UCAT, SJT, A-levels or contextual factors.

primary_selection_models.name: Holistic Review
primary_selection_models.description: Applications are reviewed using multiple factors where no fully published fixed formula is available.

primary_selection_models.name: Direct Interview If Minimum Met
primary_selection_models.description: Applicants are invited if all minimum requirements are met, usually subject to route, places or eligibility.

selection_modifiers.name: Contextual Adjustment
selection_modifiers.description: Contextual status changes academic requirements, UCAT threshold, score, ranking pool or offer requirement.

selection_modifiers.name: Widening Participation Scheme
selection_modifiers.description: Applicant is assessed under a specific widening participation scheme.

selection_modifiers.name: Guaranteed Interview
selection_modifiers.description: Eligible applicants receive an interview if minimum requirements are met.

selection_modifiers.name: SJT Exclusion
selection_modifiers.description: Certain SJT bands cause rejection, usually Band 4.

selection_modifiers.name: SJT Scoring
selection_modifiers.description: SJT band contributes points or affects ranking.

selection_modifiers.name: Tie Breaker
selection_modifiers.description: Rules used when applicants have equal selection scores.

selection_modifiers.name: Separate Applicant Pool
selection_modifiers.description: Applicants are ranked separately by fee status, domicile, route or applicant group.

selection_modifiers.name: Resit Policy Adjustment
selection_modifiers.description: Resit applicants have different requirements or restrictions.

usage.purpose: Defines the controlled list of valid interview selection models and modifiers supported by Apply Smart.
usage.rule: Each university course JSON must use one primary_model and may use multiple modifiers.
usage.important_design_rule: Modifiers in this file are labels only. If a modifier affects prediction, the detailed structured rules must be stored inside the university course JSON under interview_selection.selection_adjustments.
validation_rules: each modifier must match one selection_modifiers.modifier_id
modifier values must not be duplicated
unknown primary_model or modifier values must cause validation error
